name: ring icon cycles a live parameter readout and short labels
looks: The ring mark returns, now static and centred, and becomes a live display: a mono stat line ticks from a low value up to a higher one beneath it, a short caption explains what the number means, then the same ring hard-cuts through a couple of single-word labels inside its centre before settling on a plain descriptive phrase.
build: The ring stays fixed on screen while its caption layer swaps per beat: a mono 'KEY = value' line counts up with no easing as a pure function of time, a caption line fades in below it, then later beats replace the caption with a single word centred inside the ring, each on its own hard cut.
sound: A soft tick per digit of the count-up, then a dry tick per word swap.
prompt: Bring back the film's own mark as a fixed, calm centrepiece and use it as a live readout: a small counter inside or beside it ticks up to a number that proves the claim just made, then the same mark cycles through one-word labels naming who or what the number describes.
